discrepancies.title: Works catalog 12 SSR vs 27 full catalog discrepancy
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Initial static SSR of https://omnira.framer.website/works renders pageSize=12 projects while Framer LoadMore + CMS chunk mD0yv0kks-chunk-default-0.framercms contain all 27 projects across 5 category counts (ALL PROJECTS 27, AI 3, BUSINESS 12, ONE PAGE 5, PORTFOLIO 7).
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Render all 27 projects immediately in ALL PROJECTS with 1:1 verified category counts and URL query param ?category= sync via history.replaceState.

discrepancies.title: Missing upstream Framer spinner mask SVG (HTTP 404)
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Upstream asset https://framerusercontent.com/images/pGiXYozQ3mE4cilNOItfe2L2fUA.svg returned HTTP 404 during extraction.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Replaced broken external mask with an inline accessible SVG spinner inside ContactForm submit button.

discrepancies.title: Missing Orbitron weight 600 WOFF2 and malformed fonts.css braces
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Live hero headline uses Orbitron-SemiBold (600) while initial font scrape omitted weight 600 and left stray ' };' tokens in public/assets/fonts/fonts.css.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Downloaded Google Fonts latin subset orbitron-600-normal-latin.woff2 and cleaned stray ' };' tokens across public/assets/fonts/fonts.css (0 stray braces remaining).

discrepancies.title: React hydration mismatch #418 on 404 route navigation
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Prefix-based active route check marked root links inconsistent during 404 rendering on /works/brandora.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Updated isRouteActive in DesktopNavigation.tsx and MobileNavigation.tsx to exact pathname comparison (currentPath === href).

discrepancies.title: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) on /works
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Suspense fallback={null} around WorksContent delayed grid mount after initial paint.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Removed Suspense null fallback on /works and preloaded critical Orbitron and Chakra Petch WOFF2 files in layout.tsx.

discrepancies.title: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast, ARIA roles, and accessible name compliance
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Initial axe-core scan flagged missing role='img' on ClientRating, tablist wrapper misuse on ServiceSelector, low muted text contrast, and accessible name mismatch on buttons.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Added role='img' on ClientRating, converted ServiceSelector to button-accordion semantics, raised --color-text-muted to rgba(255,255,255,0.58), and aligned button aria-labels with visible text.

discrepancies.title: 404 page swirling vortex portal artwork
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Live /404 embeds an encrypted shader/portal visual inside its hero frame.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Captured clean 676x556 frame of the live 404 portal and generated AVIF, WebP, and JPG derivatives at public/assets/images/brand/not-found-portal.*.

discrepancies.title: 16 standalone System Stack tool SVG icons
discrepancies.referenceObservation: About page System Stack displays 16 tool icons across Design, Development, Motion, and 3D / Visual tabs.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Extracted all 16 standalone SVGs into public/assets/icons/tools/ and mapped them via src/lib/assets.ts.

discrepancies.title: Home full-page height delta (-8289px at 1440x900) due to Framer sticky spacer tracks
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Live / uses 370vh-470vh sticky scroll spacer containers for Process and Services sections (15683px total scrollHeight).
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Reconstructed interactive step/phase state selection and progress without multi-thousand-pixel empty dark scroll spacers (7394px scrollHeight), eliminating blank black vertical bands in full-page screenshots.

discrepancies.title: Omission of Framer platform promotion badge
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Live reference viewports render floating 'Made in Framer' and 'REMIX TEMPLATE' platform badges in bottom-right corner.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Intentionally omitted third-party Framer platform chrome to deliver a clean independent portfolio application.

discrepancies.title: Works page visual diff (~27.4% viewport / ~22.5% fullpage at 1440x900)
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Works section heading wraps cleanly in two-column grid on desktop while reference screenshot captures slightly narrower display tracking and Framer initial 12-card spacing.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Maintained responsive two-line heading fit and zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=1440, 0 offenders) alongside all 27 cards rendered cleanly.

discrepancies.title: Hero Canvas 2D halftone dot-matrix, rotating headline word, and Berlin live clock
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Home hero features live time-varying Canvas 2D dot-matrix portrait, 3000ms rotating barrel headline word, and 1Hz Europe/Berlin clock.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Exact pixel diff at instant of screenshot capture reflects frame phase differences (~9.365% Home 1440x900 viewport diff), not static layout errors.

discrepancies.title: Upstream reference spelling anomalies
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Live reference contains typos: 'bradora.studio' (Brandora display text), 'girdo.studio' (Grido display text), 'hello@omniro.studio' label next to mailto:hello@omnira.studio href, 'Not suire yet' (Timeline dropdown), 'Landing poge' (Project Type dropdown), 'STAUS:' / 'purpuse' (About terminal).
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Preserved project display domain strings ('bradora.studio', 'girdo.studio') for reference parity where shown in Works cards while normalizing interactive contact email/labels ('hello@omnira.studio', 'Not sure yet', 'Landing page') for production usability.

discrepancies.title: External project detail links vs internal project routes
discrepancies.referenceObservation: Live site has zero /works/:slug routes; sitemap confirms only /, /about, /works, /contact, /404, and all 27 cards link externally to *.framer.website / *.framer.ai.
discrepancies.implementationDecision: Matched reference 1:1 with 27 external links and standard custom 404 response for nonexistent paths such as /works/brandora.
